_help: Copy to site.json, fill in the values, then start the app with ADVQM_SITE_CONFIG=$PWD/site.json make run. site.json is gitignored. Keys left out keep the built-in default; see docs/installation.md.
name: my-cluster
_help_qe: How a job gets QE: 'module' loads the cluster's QE install; srun starts the MPI ranks.
_help_scratch: Where QE runs during a job. $USER and $SLURM_JOBID are expanded by the job.
_help_slurm: Empty values are left out of the job script.
_help_app: runs_dir and pseudo_dir must be visible at the same path from the compute nodes. gpu_types values are SLURM GRES names (e.g. a100); contact: [] hides the Contact section.
